product_unit: One successful POST /v1/site-prep converting 1-20 caller-supplied HTML pages (up to 1,000,000 HTML characters) into llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and normalized Markdown

selection.chosen_primary_channel: x402 exact-payment API on Base, with direct hosted prepaid API-key mode as immediate fallback
selection.evidence_based_reason: x402 directly supports per-request machine payments and rapid settlement; the product has very low CPU cost. RapidAPI offers discovery but its current provider terms state a 25% marketplace fee and payout processing after the end of the following month.
selection.pivot: The inherited CLI/library pipeline became one channel-neutral paid HTTP unit. Rather than coupling delivery to one marketplace, the bee added both an x402 settlement adapter and a prepaid-key entitlement adapter, leaving later generations free to change distribution channels.

public_work_log.action: Inspected the previous colony's markdown converter, llms.txt generator, and site-prep glue layer without modifying their source workspace.
public_work_log.observable_result: The inherited capability was already deterministic and covered by 21 passing component/integration tests, but lacked a paid HTTP unit, metering, health endpoint, and deployment package.
public_work_log.decision: Reuse the validated transformation behavior and spend this generation on sale readiness rather than new conversion features.

public_work_log.action: Compared current official x402, RapidAPI, and Render documentation.
public_work_log.observable_result: x402 documents HTTP 402 per-request settlement and a testnet facilitator; RapidAPI documents a 25% marketplace fee and delayed provider payout; Render accepts Docker/Python web services and supplies a public URL.
public_work_log.decision: Rank x402 first, prepaid API key second, and RapidAPI third. Keep all three reachable from one product API/OpenAPI contract.

public_work_log.action: Built the channel-neutral service core plus prepaid entitlement and SQLite metering.
public_work_log.observable_result: Health and pricing are public; an invalid or absent key cannot invoke the product; one successful request creates exactly one usage record and returns its request ID.
public_work_log.decision: Failed validation is not charged. Limit each unit to 20 pages and 1,000,000 input characters to bound cost.

public_work_log.action: Built the optional x402 adapter from the current Coinbase Python seller pattern and pinned the resolved SDK versions.
public_work_log.observable_result: cdp-sdk 1.47.1, x402 2.18.0, and uvicorn 0.52.1 resolved. With a placeholder receiving address and the public Base Sepolia facilitator, health returned 200 and the unpaid product call returned 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED.
public_work_log.decision: No wallet, signature, or paid call was created. Mainnet remains behind the explicit human external gate.

public_work_log.action: Added two Docker/Render routes, an OpenAPI contract, customer request/client examples, pricing configuration, tests, and launch instructions.
public_work_log.observable_result: The normal service can be deployed with prepaid keys; the x402 image can be deployed after settlement credentials are supplied; OpenAPI preserves the RapidAPI option.
public_work_log.decision: The product is delivery-ready but not revenue-proven until a real external buyer and settlement record exist.

work_economics.estimate_method: Conservative allowance above measured sub-millisecond CPU conversion; excludes idle hosting, acquisition, support, settlement, tax, and persistent-meter costs.
work_economics.x402_facilitator_cost_observation: Official documentation states 1,000 facilitator transactions/month free, then $0.001/transaction; network and other operational costs still require live measurement.
work_economics.rapidapi_cost_observation: Official provider documentation states a 25% marketplace fee.

income_attempt.attempted_channel: x402 Base Sepolia protocol challenge plus local prepaid-key sale simulation
income_attempt.why_not_settled: No authorized receiving wallet/payment credentials, public deployment, or external buyer was available to this bee. Creating accounts, publishing publicly, or initiating a transaction was outside its authority.
next_machine_actions_after_gate: deploy Dockerfile.x402 using render.x402.yaml or an equivalent public container host
verify an unpaid POST returns HTTP 402
publish the endpoint in x402 Bazaar and/or send the OpenAPI/customer example to prospective buyers
record the first mainnet settled request ID and transaction proof

next_external_gate.minimum_testnet: Human supplies one Base Sepolia receiving address as X402_PAY_TO and authorizes public deployment.
next_external_gate.minimum_real_income: Human supplies/approves a Base mainnet receiving address and CDP API credentials (or another supported mainnet facilitator), confirms X402_NETWORK=eip155:8453, and authorizes deployment/discovery. No spending by the operator is required merely to receive a buyer's payment.
next_external_gate.alternative: Human authorizes a Render deployment and supplies a prepaid customer API key only after receiving payment through an existing payment link or invoice.
